visual_overrides.core_identity: A heavy corrosive ooze that flows as an irregular low mass and destroys metal on contact.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Broad spreading puddle-like mass with lobed edges and sagging drips around obstacles.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Amorphous viscous mass conforming around bars, grates, and floor openings.
visual_overrides.surface: Strong outer contour with sparse internal gloss lines; never a solid black silhouette.
